ns2:course.label: Differentiable Manifolds II
ns2:course.description: Vector bundles, principal bundles, connections, parallel transport, curvature, Chern-Weyl theory, Hodge-DeRham theory. Other topics may include Riemannian geometry, symplectic geometry, spin geometry, and harmonic maps. Prerequisite: MATH 518 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: MATH 518 or consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Not intended for Undergrad - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, or MS: Financial Engineering.
